description: Use this when the user asks what a site's recent checks, response times or failures looked like, or how a cron job, content check or dependency has been running. Returns the most recent checks of the site, or of one of its content checks, dependencies or cron jobs (runs, durations, late or failed runs), newest first. Not for uptime percentages or totals over a range: use get_report.

check.description: A content check, dependency or cron job on the site, by id or name. Leave out for the site's own uptime checks.

from.description: Instead of range: where the window starts, a date such as 2026-07-01 (in your time zone) or RFC 3339. Goes with to. A window is at most 90 days, within the history your plan keeps.

site.description: The site's id, name or part of its URL.

to.description: Instead of range: where the window ends, a date (the whole day is included) or RFC 3339.

name: get_monitor_history
title: Get recent checks
